mapper.insert: insert into homework.recordtask (subject, content, name, class_number,checkdate, create_time, completed,supplementary,school) values (#{or.subject},#{or.content},#{or.name},#{or.classNumber},#{or.checkdate},#{or.createTime},#{or.completed},#{or.supplementary},#{or.school})
mapper.update: update homework.record set completed = #{changecompleted}, create_time = #{nowtime} where content = #{content} and class_number = #{classNumber} and checkdate = #{checkdate} and subject = #{subject} and completed is null
update homework.recordtask set completed = 2 where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select name from homework.record where class_number = #{classNumber} and content = #{content} and checkdate = #{checkdate} and level= #{level} and subject = #{subject}
select * from homework.recordtask where id in #{id}
